Fourth pillar: Enhancing the governance and transparency of the banking sector

96.

This pillar would support increased transparency of the financial system and

improved governance of BFIs, including state-controlled BFIs. The process of

improving the quality of financial reporting by BFIs has been advanced by the issuance of

a guideline by the NRB governing the staged transition of the banking sector to the NFRS.
